port_overlap_scope: Both P instances' recorded GET intervals are excluded. The amount of instantaneous per-port headroom, actual flow-to-port mapping, immutable source keys and destination page fences are not observed. Device duration is available on rank 0 with host submission times, without a device time origin.
shared_prefix_scope: Intersect measured missing Attention spans using a conservative token-LCP bound. The read shape is checked per call, including all three private state objects per rank. Store key identities and destination page layout are unobserved. This does not merge ranks or alter batch membership. Copy cost is an illustrative per-rank byte cost; service saved is assumed linear in the removed share of each API and does not reschedule the network.
